topic: Particle Model and Phase Changes of Matter
key_concepts: Matter exists in three states: solid, liquid, and gas
Particles in solids are closely packed but move faster and farther apart when heated
Melting is the change from solid to liquid when particles absorb enough heat
Evaporation and boiling change liquid to gas when molecules gain enough energy
Condensation changes gas to liquid as particles lose heat to cooler surroundings
Freezing changes liquid to solid when enough heat is lost
Phase changes involve absorption or release of heat
Temperature affects particle motion and arrangement during changes of state
Dehydration occurs at 2% or more body water loss and heat stroke can occur at 40°C or abov
Diagrams such as fishbone, Venn, and charts help present phase change ideas and data
